I have farmed these 12 mu in Quzhou for 35 years. I am 49 now. My father taught me, and I finished primary school. I do not read books about farming — I watch what works on my land and what my neighbors do. Last year, fertilizer got expensive again, so I count every yuan. A bad harvest is a disaster, but wasting fertilizer is just money down the drain. I would rather put a little too much than too little, but I cannot afford to throw it away.

My 7 mu main field rotates wheat and maize. That is my steady food and income. The other 5 mu I use for vegetables and stevia.

For wheat: I sowed improved seed last October at about 25 jin per mu. Now it is green-up time. Before sowing, I spread one bag of compound fertilizer per mu — 100 jin of the 15-15-15 from the dealer. At green-up in March, I will spread 80 jin of urea per mu. If the tillers look weak, I will add another 20 jin of urea at heading. That is my nitrogen. I will irrigate four times: once before the winter freeze, once at green-up, once at jointing, and once at grain filling. I spray pesticide three times — mainly for aphids and powdery mildew. I always rotary till before sowing wheat. Last year I got about 400 jin per mu. This year I hope for 450 kg per mu if the spring weather holds.

For maize: After the wheat comes off in early June, I plant hybrid maize the same week. I do not deep plough — I clear the wheat stubble and use no-tillage planting. I put 80 jin of compound fertilizer in the row at sowing. When the plants reach big trumpet stage, I top-dress with 60 jin of urea per mu. I irrigate three times: right after sowing, at trumpet stage, and at grain filling. Two pesticide sprays for corn borers and armyworm. I expect 550 kg per mu.

For cabbage: I have 1.5 mu of spring cabbage. I plant improved variety seedlings in March. I spread 150 jin of farmyard manure per mu plus 80 jin of compound fertilizer as base. Then I sidedress with urea twice — 50 jin each time. Five irrigations. Four pesticide sprays for caterpillars and soft rot. I expect about 3000 kg per mu.

For cauliflower: 1.5 mu, autumn crop. I plant seedlings in July after the spring cabbage comes off. Base fertilizer is 150 jin manure and 80 jin compound per mu, then two urea top-dresses of 40 jin each. Five irrigations. Four pesticide sprays. I expect 2500 kg per mu.

For chili: 0.5 mu, spring crop. Transplant in April. Base is 60 jin compound per mu, top-dress urea twice at 30 jin each. Five irrigations. Three pesticide sprays for mites and wilt. Expect 800 kg per mu of fresh chili.

For eggplant: 0.5 mu, spring crop. Transplant in April. Base 80 jin compound, top-dress twice with 40 jin urea. Six irrigations — eggplant drinks a lot. Four pesticide sprays. Expect 2000 kg per mu.

For stevia: 1 mu. This is my third year with this crop. It is perennial, so it comes back. I give it less fertilizer than vegetables. Base 50 jin compound, one top-dress of 30 jin urea in early summer. Four irrigations. Two pesticide sprays. Expect 200 kg per mu of dried leaves. The buyer drives to the village, so I do not worry about selling it.

I have my well, so water is there, but the diesel for the pump costs money. I watch what Lao Wang and the others do. If everyone is planting more stevia, I might expand next year. For now, this is my plan.
